raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the kinship logic by taking Karl Salvator’s mother (Princess Maria Antonia of the Two Sicilies) as Dolores’s paternal grandmother. This confused the paternal grandmother with the paternal great-grandmother, despite the source clearly stating Leopold Salvator’s mother was Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies.
